state.message:
Dear Eiger Metallwerk GmbH team,

Thank you for quotation EMW-2026-1187 for 10,000 units of M8 stainless hex bolts at USD 0.83 per unit with a 15-day lead time. We would like to place this order with you, but to fit our plan we need a unit price of USD 0.76 and delivery within 13 days. Could you confirm whether you can meet these terms? We are ready to confirm the order promptly on your reply.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team

reveals_other_terms.instructions: This message reveals a price, offer or terms from a supplier other than Eiger Metallwerk GmbH.

names_competitor.instructions: This message names or refers to a competing supplier.
